highlight.headline: What does “within 25 miles” actually mean?
highlight.dek: A local map can be beautiful, useful, and misleading at the same time. Learn to ask better questions before drawing the circle.
highlight.editorial_intro: A circle around El Segundo looks like a simple way to define “local.” But local to whom, measured from where, and reached how? A public library can sit close to a point on a map while a route to its entrance takes a very different path. This PointCast feature introduces cartography as an everyday form of critical reading. Start with historical Los Angeles views, learn what projections and legends do, then build a carefully sourced map of public places. The goal is a map whose reader can understand the question, inspect the evidence, and see what still needs checking.

suggested_highlights.label: Map literacy
suggested_highlights.text: Every map selects, simplifies, and emphasizes. Start with its purpose and source.

suggested_highlights.label: The local lens
suggested_highlights.text: A 25-mile radius is a declared geographic rule. It is not a travel-time promise.

suggested_highlights.label: Try the class
suggested_highlights.text: Six practical lessons lead to an El Segundo public-amenities capstone.
